name: qfd_io_serdes_adapter_rxd512-351607d29tc
purpose: GAPS-DESIGN item 1: Qwen SerDes link at line rate. RXD 128 -> 512 (credit RTT ~460 FDI cycles at 223-cycle KP4+PCS one way; rate sweep tb RATE=1: 128 -> 0.290, 256 -> 0.591, 512 -> 1.000 words/cycle); receive buffer = 8 x ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2 with macro-output capture flops + 4-entry skid. Route at TC (OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC), mm FF hold HM 50, H1 die-master SDC. Supersedes qfd_io_serdes_adapter-646cf264dtt (RXD 128).
